messages:
alex: FYI: running the new evalkit-next starter with LlamaIndex+LangChain under concurrent SSR loads shows intermittent 401s and the page hangs while the SDK retries.
maria: Can you share a quick repro? steps and runtime.
alex: Repo: github.com/redwood/evalkit-next-modular
Steps:
1) npm i && RW_KEY=... npm run dev
2) open /rag-demo in 6 tabs and hammer refresh
Result: some /v1/generate calls return 401s. Edge runtime sample keeps retrying inline which increases SSR latency.
sam: Edge vs Node? Edge has slightly different auth plumbing.
alex: Using Edge (default sample). Handler:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, runtime: 'edge' })
export async function POST(req) {
  const { prompt } = await req.json()
  return client.generate({ model: 'open-rw/llama-13b', prompt })
}
```
ingrid: Any rw headers in the 401 responses?
alex: Yes:
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-rw-request-id: rq_01abcxyz
retry-after: 1
{"error": "invalid_api_key"}
maria: Sounds like the edge client isn't firing the auth refresh hook on transient 401s. Node client had that patch earlier.
sam: Confirmed. Edge client currently doesn't invoke the refresh callback for 401 flows and defaults to aggressive retries. Short-term mitigations:
- reduce maxRetries in sample
- move token exchange to server-only endpoint
alex: Quick sample patch:
```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  runtime: 'edge',
  defaultOptions: { maxRetries: 1, retryDelayMs: 200 }
})
```
ingrid: Please PR that and add an integration test firing 6 parallel requests asserting no 401s.
maria: Good call. Add a small eval harness test so CI catches regressions.
sam: Filed SDK ticket SDK-3245: "edge: auth-refresh parity + concurrent SSR retry behavior". Assigning to @sam.
devex-bot: Created issue https://go/repo/issues/3245 1 "edge: auth refresh parity + concurrent SSR retry behavior" Labels: devex, sdk, high-prio
alex: I'll open the sample PR today with reduced retries + server token exchange docs + parallel test. Thanks :thumbsup:
ingrid: Also update README to recommend Node runtime for high-concurrency SSR until parity is fixed.
sam: Long-term: consider SSR-friendly client that disables background retries or make retries opt-in.
alex: Marking as "sample patched (WIP)". Will link PR when ready.
